text_block_list.text:
!? Th-This is—!!
"A Compilation of Reactions to Royce-chan's Casual Clothes"?!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Huh, even a 'Royce-chan Best Moments Compilation'!?
So many compilation videos just tonight..."

text_block_list.name: Comments Section
text_block_list.text:
"Her taste is way too good? Totally stanning."
"She's painfully cute."
"People are finally waking up to Royce-chan's charm, huh."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Fufufufu!
—It's here, my era has arrived!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Now is the best time to gather impressions and information while it's easy to search. Time to analyze, Royce!

And so, Royce and Royce stayed up late
analyzing fan trends...
and didn't get much rest.
